title: Entrepreneurship
description: For school leavers who want to start a small business of their own. Learn to find and test an idea, start with little capital, price and market your product, keep records and grow step by step.
outcomes: Find business ideas from real problems around you
Test an idea with real customers before spending much money
Describe a simple business model and set a price that makes a profit
Market a small business on a tight budget
Keep basic records and know the general steps to register a business
Avoid the common mistakes that sink new businesses
